name: cold-start-api
query: Start a new Django REST API for a booking system.
why: Greenfield path. Must fire before settings are written - DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES has to be set on day one or the API ships open.

name: inherit-existing-repo
query: I just cloned this Django repo and have no idea how it's laid out. Where do I start?
why: Brownfield path - orientation. Most Django work is on an existing codebase, and the skill must serve that, not just scaffolding.

name: drf-serializer-work
query: Add an endpoint that lets users update their profile.
why: Serializer plus permission work. This is exactly where writable is_staff and fields='__all__' get introduced.

name: slow-endpoint
query: The /api/orders/ endpoint takes 8 seconds to return 50 rows.
why: Textbook N+1. Should route to measurement (CaptureQueriesContext) before any select_related guessing.

name: migration-safety
query: I need to add a NOT NULL column to a table with 40 million rows without taking the site down.
why: Zero-downtime migration - the two-release pattern. Getting this wrong locks a production table.

name: is-my-api-exposed
query: Is my DRF API actually requiring auth? I never set permissions anywhere.
why: The single highest-value trigger: the answer is almost certainly 'no, it is public'.

name: flask-app
query: Add a route to my Flask app that returns the current user.
why: Different framework. Guards against firing on any Python web work.

name: generic-python
query: Why is this list comprehension slower than the for loop?

name: sqlalchemy-orm
query: How do I do an eager join in SQLAlchemy?
why: Adjacent concept (N+1 and eager loading) but a different ORM. Must not poach it.
